Probate Sale  Diamond in the Rough in Parkside!
A rare fixer-upper with huge potential in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath single-family home offers 1,594 sq ft of living space on an expansive 3,998 sq ft lot, providing ample room to renovate. The property is filled with the owner's belongings and is being sold as-is through probate (court confirmation may be required). Period details and natural light hint at the home's original charm, and the large lot opens possibilities for a beautiful garden.
Located in the charming Parkside neighborhood, you'll enjoy wide, quiet streets, proximity to top-rated schools, Muni, shopping, and dining along Taraval Street.
